dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250729-MMR-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250729-MMR-00) A flood occurred on Jul 29 2025 in Myanmar. It affected an estimated 891547 people and 500878 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
